BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-ISIS
BundleInfo.Author: NanoSyrinx
BundleInfo.Description:
ISIS (In Silico Immunogenicity Studies) provides B-cell epitope prediction using established amino acid property scales including Emini surface accessibility, Parker hydrophilicity, Chou-Fasman beta-turn propensity, and Kolaskar-Tongaonkar antigenicity.
Predictions can be visualized directly on protein structures using color gradients to highlight immunogenic regions.

Command.name: isis predict
Command.Synopsis: Predict B-cell epitopes on structure sequences
Command.Description:
Run epitope prediction using amino acid property scales. Results are stored as residue attributes for visualization.
Usage: isis predict #1 [method emini] [window 7] [threshold 1.0]

Command.name: isis color
Command.Synopsis: Color structure by epitope prediction scores
Command.Description:
Apply a color gradient based on prediction scores. Low scores are shown in the first color, high in the last.
Usage: isis color #1 [method emini] [palette white:yellow:red]

Command.name: isis epitopes
Command.Description:
Color only the residues within predicted epitope regions.
Usage: isis epitopes #1 [method emini] [color red]

Command.name: isis clear
Command.Synopsis: Remove ISIS prediction attributes from structures
Command.Description:
Clear all ISIS-related attributes from residues.
Usage: isis clear #1

Command.name: isis list
Command.Description:
Show all available epitope prediction methods with descriptions.
Usage: isis list
